meta.name: QTKHCN Screen Specifications
meta.description: Screen layouts and specifications for QTKHCN application

screens.name: Subsystem List
screens.description: Landing page showing all subsystems (PH1, PH2, PH3, PH4) as cards
components: Centered content with subsystem cards in grid
Each card: logo box with color + subsystem name + description + arrow

screens.name: Dashboard
screens.description: Main dashboard with stats, charts, and recent items
components: Stats row (4 cards): Total dossiers, Processing, Completed, Rejected

screens.name: Dossier List
screens.description: List of all dossiers with filters and search
components: Table with columns: ID, Tên đề tài, Loại, Cấp, Trạng thái, Bước hiện tại, Thao tác

layout.table: full width with horizontal scroll on mobile

screens.name: Dossier Detail
screens.description: Detailed view of a single dossier with tabs and actions
components: Page header: back button, title, action buttons (Edit, Delete)
- Info Card: key-value pairs (Mã, Tên, Lĩnh vực, Chủ nhiệm, etc.)
- Process Card: BPMN diagram showing current step
- Documents Card: list of documents with View/Download buttons
- Committee Card (conditional): auto-created when step 7 or 10
- Quick Actions Card: buttons for workflow actions

screens.name: Form Library
screens.description: List of all form templates (eForms) with usage stats
components: Page header: icon (FormOutlined red), title, Create button
Breadcrumb: Hệ thống QTKHCN / Thư viện biểu mẫu
Stats row (4 cards): Total forms, Bound, Unbound, Configured steps
Table columns: Tên biểu mẫu, Mã (formKey), Loại, Số trường, Đang dùng, Thao tác
Actions per row: Preview (eye), Design (edit), Delete (trash)
Modal for create: Form fields (Tên, Mã, Loại, Mô tả)

screens.name: Form Designer
screens.description: Drag-and-drop form builder with component palette and properties panel
components: Page header: back button, breadcrumb, title with code, Cancel/Save buttons
- Grouped by type: Text, Number, Selection, Date, etc.

screens.name: Process Catalog
components: Table: Process name, Version, Status, Steps count, Actions

screens.name: Process Detail
components: Page header: process name, version badge, Edit button
Tab bar: BPMN Diagram, Configuration, Versions
- Canvas: rendered BPMN with swimlanes and tasks

screens.name: Council Committee List
screens.description: List of all review committees (Hội đồng xét duyệt)
components: Page header: TeamOutlined icon, title, Create button
LEFT: List of councils as cards
- Card shows: Council ID, Phiên, Ngày, Trạng thái, Thành viên count
- Click to select and show details
- Info: ID, Tên đề tài, Phiên, Ngày thành lập, Trạ thái
- Members table: Họ tên, Vai trò (color-coded), Đơn vị

screens.name: Approval Matrix
components: - Columns: Roles (Chủ tịch, Phản biện, etc.)
Edit mode: click cell to assign/remove approver

screens.name: Process Monitor
screens.description: Real-time process monitoring with BPMN visualization
components: - Completed steps in green, current in red, pending in gray
Side panel: Instance list with status

screens.name: User Management
components: Page header: title + Add User button
Table: Avatar+Name, Email, Đơn vị, Vai trò, Trạng thái, Actions

screens.name: Org Structure
components: Page header: title + Add Unit button
Tree view: hierarchical display of departments
Each node: department name, unit code, member count
